            return: $data['return'],
            function: $data['function'],

            with space: $data['with space'],
            dotted.name: $data['dotted.name'],
            Anything: $data['Anything'],
            : $data[''],
            b: $data['b'],
            01: $data['01'],
            a: $data['a'],
            4294967295: $data['4294967295'],
        );
    }
